senses.gloss:
रेभ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. crackling; sounding
loudly; (अस्), m. a praiser, reciter of praises, panegyrist,
celebrator; a talker, prattler, chatterer; N. of a
Ṛṣi (who was cast into a well by the Asuras, and
rescued by the Aśvins after having lain there for ten
nights and nine days, see Ṛg-veda I. 112, 5. 116,
24, &c.); N. of the author of Ṛg-veda VIII. 97
(having the patronymic Kāśyapa).
—रेभ-सूनू,
m. du. two sons of Rebha, the authors of the hymns
Ṛg-veda IX. 99, 100.
रेभण, अम्, n. the lowing of kine.

रेभत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. crackling, sounding;
praising.
रेभिल and रेभिलक, अस्, m. a proper N.
रेभ् रेभ्. See rt. रिभ्, p. 846, col. 3.
